headline: Brazil FGV Economic Uncertainty Index Declines 1.8 Points in October
summary: The Getulio Vargas Foundation reported that Brazil's Economic Uncertainty Index fell 1.8 points in October to 109.0 points.
why: Macroeconomic uncertainty indicators track business confidence levels and sentiment trends that guide corporate investment decisions.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Declining uncertainty indices suggest improved macroeconomic stability and business sentiment.
